en: Aragi, where are you?
Ah...
You're...

jp: さらってきたインセストか
en: The Incest we snatched from that Church facility a while back.

jp: ありがとうございます
en: Um... Thank you.

jp: わたしはレアと申します
本当に感謝しています
en: My name is Rea. I'm truly grateful to you for saving me.

jp: 助けてやった覚えなどない
en: I don't recall ever saving you.
No.

jp: 貴方は、教団の実験動物でしか
なかったわたしを、外の世界に
連れ出してくれました
en: I was nothing but the Church's lab animal. You brought me out into the world outside.

jp: 助け出してやったわけじゃない
力を得るために必要だから
en: I didn't rescue you. I took you because I needed you to gain power. That's all.

jp: オレが生きるための糧でしかない
en: You Incests are nothing but fodder to keep me alive.

jp: ええ・・それでも、もう一度
外の世界に触れたいという
わたしの願いは叶えられました
en: Yes... Even so, my wish to touch the outside world once more was granted.

jp: アラギを見ていないか？
en: Hey, you. Have you seen Aragi?
Ah, no...

jp: パスカの気配もない・・・
en: No sign of the Pasca either...

jp: 例の元仲間のところにでも
en: Did he go to see those old comrades of his?

jp: オレには関係ないことだ
en: Whatever. It's nothing to do with me.
Um, Abel-sama...

jp: 力を採り尽くしてしまえば
en: Once your power is drained dry, I'll have no more use for you.

jp: 触れることは出来ないままだ
en: Until then, you won't be free to touch the outside world.

jp: 自分がインセストに生まれて
しまったのを恨むんだな
en: ...If you want someone to blame, blame yourself for being born an Incest.

jp: ・・・・・・はぁ、はぁ、はぁ

en: Kaff, kaff kaff!
Ugh...... Damn it!!

jp: ・・・発作が前よりひどい
en: ...The fits are worse than before.
Kaff kaff, kaff!
Luca!!
Don't go wandering off on your own.

jp: アタシがどこに行こうと
en: Where I go is my own business, isn't it?
Where are you planning to go?
Shut up! Leave me alone!

jp: ルカは相変わらずだなぁ
en: Kukuku... Luca never changes, does she.
Aragi!?

jp: だいぶ進行しているようだな
en: Symptoms like those... it's come along quite a way, hasn't it.

jp: 羽根なしどもを狩ってやったら
en: Leave it be and she'll die, you know? Why not go hunt some wingless?

jp: 一、二匹切り裂いて血をすすれば
少しは楽になるんだぜ？
en: Slice open one or two and slurp their blood, and it eases up a bit, you know?

jp: あいつは気休めの癒しなどに
en: It's Luca's choice. She won't cling to some stopgap relief.
Luca's choice, huh...

jp: その意志に背くとしても、
ルカがあの病から助かるとしたら
en: Say Luca could be cured of that sickness, against her wishes. What then?
...What do you mean?

jp: 目の色が変わったぜ、ザイオン？
en: Kukuku... That look in your eyes just changed, Zion.

jp: お前は何を知っている？
en: What do you know?

jp: 本人と適合する＜インセスト＞の
血と髄でルカは助かる
en: A Compatible One... The marrow of an Incest compatible with her, and Luca is saved.

jp: そんな話誰が信じるか
en: ...Ridiculous. Who'd believe a story like that?
I went and found one. Luca's Compatible One.
A pasty-faced little brat, she was.

jp: 横取りしてやるつもりが
またあの六翼だ・・・
en: I meant to snatch her from the Embryon, but that six-wing got in the way again...
Embryon?

jp: てめーらも見たんだろ？
教会を襲ってた白い化け物だよ
en: You lot saw them too, right? The white monsters that attacked the church.

jp: まさか、リリスとかいうガキを
さらっていった奴らのことか？！
en: You mean... the ones that carried off that kid, Lilis!?
Oh? So that brat's called Lilis.

jp: お前は何を企んでいるんだ
en: ...What are you scheming, telling me all this?
Kukuku... You want to hear it?

jp: あそこにいるのは・・・
en: Huh? Isn't that... over there...

jp: そんなところで何してるんだよ
en: Heeey, Zion! What're you doing over there?
Listen close... ......... That's it.

jp: 後はお前の好きにしな
en: Kukuku... The rest is up to you.

jp: 一緒にいるのはアラギ！？
en: ...No way. Is that Aragi with him!?
Don't screw with me!!
Whoa there. Don't get mad, Zion.
You all right, Zion!?
Kukuku... Your friends have arrived, I see.

jp: アラギ、お前は絶対に殺す！！
en: Aragi, I will kill you. I swear it!!

jp: 俺にはパスカがいるんだぜ？
お前とその羽根なしの二人で
何が出来るっていうんだよ
en: I've got the Pasca, remember? You and the wingless, what can the pair of you do?

jp: しっぽを巻いて逃げな！
en: That's how it is. If you don't want to die, tuck your tail and run!

jp: アイツのために汚れるつもりなら
俺も一緒に地下を歩いてやるぜ
en: ...Or if you'd dirty your hands for her, I'll walk the underground with you.
Shut up, Aragi!

jp: 挑発にのるなよザイオン！
ここは、いったん退くぞ
en: Don't rise to it, Zion! We're pulling back for now.
...Don't give me orders!

jp: おいおい、状況考えろよ？
en: Hey, hey, think about the situation here!

jp: お前一人で勝手に逃げろ
en: If you want to run, run by yourself.

jp: パスカの大群を呼ばれたら
いくらお前だってヤバイだろ！？
en: If he calls a swarm of Pasca, even you'd be in deep trouble!
Like I care!!

jp: ・・・たく、熱くなりやがって
悪いけど、ここはお前も一緒に
逃げてもらうって決めたからな！
en: ...Jeez, so hot-headed. Sorry, but I've decided you're running with us!
What!!
......They got away, huh.

jp: フッ、くっくっくっ・・・
ハハハハハハハハハッ！！！
en: Heh. Kukuku... Fwahaha... HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
